role: The overworld density pass of ChunkProviderGenerate: the provider's noise generators built in constructor order, the 5x33x5 density field (func_147423_a) with biome-weighted depth and scale, and its trilinear interpolation into stone, water and air (func_147424_a).
notes: All arrays are stack locals of fixed size (825 doubles per noise); loops are fixed-bound. Called from chunkgen.c when a chunk is generated, inside the server tick as chunks load. denormalize_clamp is a local copy of MathHelper.denormalizeClamp; the MathHelper path was assumed at oracle/src/util/MathHelper.java and is checked by tools/index_check.c. The biome layer stack (layers.c) and noise generators (noise.c) are separate files.
